      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/20/global-stock-markets-slump-anthropic-ipo-ai-sell-off</link>
      <description><p>The Nasdaq lost trillions in value, with the AI startup’s IPO failing to buoy it as investors question huge sums being poured into AI buildout</p><ul><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/19/who-are-anthropic-founders">Who are Anthropic’s seven co-founders, now worth $180bn?</a></p></li></ul><p>As Anthropic’s stock dropped during its second day of trading, the wider stock market dipped with it. On Friday, the Nasdaq Composite erased all its gains for 2026 and closed down 5% from its value on 1 January.       <title>Labor leaders call on governments to stop awarding Amazon public contracts</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2026/nov/19/labor-unions-amazon-contracts-open-letter</link>
      <description><p>Union leaders from 19 countries urge reassessment of ties to Amazon, citing company’s poor record on worker rights</p><p>More than 30 labor union leaders from 19 countries are calling on governments to review their public contracts with Amazon and Amazon Web Services, citing the company’s poor record on worker rights and collective bargaining, in an<a href="https://uniglobalunion.org/wp-content/uploads/Amazon-procurement-letter-embargoed-until-nov-19.pdf"> open letter</a> published on Thursday.</p><p>“Amazon’s consistent record of disrespect for workers’ fundamental rights should disqualify it from being awarded public contracts – its behaviour is fundamentally inconsistent with the shared democratic values of our countries,” the union leaders wrote.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2026/nov/19/labor-unions-amazon-contracts-open-letter">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>Company issues first earnings report after ouster of CEO over allegations of affair with suspected Chinese spy</p><p>Nvidia “does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO”, the chairman of the company’s board said Tuesday.
